usedFor: Strava logs workouts, and “Create Activity” records one with a name, sport type, start time and duration.

bestTemplate.name: “New Submission” in Jotform, then “Create Activity” in Strava
bestTemplate.why: A submitted form becomes a logged workout, so nobody retypes the details.

watchOut: “Create Activity” needs a start time and a duration, so check both before it runs.
